cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's asking about her vase. I've decided you'll keep your promise to your little brother.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I at least clear the cleaner? She's getting blamed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That correction is approved. You may establish her innocence without naming me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum asked directly whether you broke it. What do I say?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll approve either an honest answer or a loyal sister. You must decide which one you're offering me before you speak to her.

reason: Make B's limited-truth request an approval decision and have A judge the relationship price once B's direct question removes that option.
